title: Microsoft Purview Insider Risk Management: alert classification replaces dismissal reasons
notes: claim 45: severity major on a rationale: risk rating lowered to minor; ratings are judgements and cannot hold a page
summary: The roadmap facts, existing alert permissions and licensing are supported, and searches confirmed the narrowly stated documentation gaps. The risk rationale should say no new data source is described rather than claiming none is read; the role-membership path also stops before the documented editing controls.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing; rationale: cost
claims.claim: No licence specific to alert classification has been published, and the roadmap names none.
claims.quote: Searched: "insider risk" "alert classification" licensing billing meter reasons existing alerts; opened service description, insider-risk-management-plan and insider-risk-management-configure; read roadmap. General licensing is stated, but no classification-specific licence.

claims.claim: No meter specific to alert classification has been published.
claims.quote: Searched: "insider risk" "alert classification" licensing billing meter reasons existing alerts; opened service description and insider-risk-management-configure. The latter documents billing for some indicators, not classification.

claims.where: front matter: defaultState; Why it matters; Open questions; rationale: risk
claims.claim: The arrival default for this classification change is not stated.
claims.quote: Searched: "insider risk" "alert classification" permissions settings enable default PowerShell; read roadmap and opened activities, permissions, settings and configure pages. None states the new classification default.

claims.claim: Learn does not yet describe the planned Purview alert classification feature.
claims.quote: Searched: "insider risk" "alert classification" "True positive"; opened insider-risk-management-activities and permissions. Results describe existing dismissal reasons and Defender mappings, not the planned replacement in Purview.

claims.claim: The new predefined classification reasons have not been documented.
claims.quote: Searched: "Insider Risk Management" "classification" "prerequisites" "reasons"; opened insider-risk-management-activities. It lists existing dismissal reasons, not the new predefined reasons.

claims.claim: The relationship between the new Purview classifications and existing alert statuses is not documented.
claims.quote: Searched: "insider risk" "alert classification" "True positive"; opened activities and read defender-xdr/irm-investigate-alerts-defender search excerpt. Its mapping is between existing Defender classifications and Purview statuses, not the new Purview feature.

claims.where: What's changing; Why it matters; Open questions
claims.claim: What happens to dismissal reasons already recorded on past alerts is not documented.
claims.quote: Searched: "insider risk" "alert classification" licensing billing meter reasons existing alerts; opened insider-risk-management-activities. No migration or reclassification of historical dismissal reasons is described.

claims.where: controls[0].note; Risk assessment: Security & identity; Scope; Governance controls; Open questions
claims.claim: Which role groups can use the new classification capability is not yet documented.
claims.quote: Searched: "insider risk" "alert classification" permissions settings enable default PowerShell; opened permissions and activities. Existing alert access and dismissal roles are documented; the new classification permission is not.

claims.claim: Microsoft Learn documents no setting or administrator switch for classification itself.
claims.quote: Searched: "insider risk" "alert classification" permissions settings enable default PowerShell; opened insider-risk-management-settings, permissions, activities and configure. No classification-specific setting or switch is documented.

claims.claim: Rollout mechanics for the classification change are not stated.
claims.quote: Searched: "Purview" "alert classification" "data" "rollout"; read roadmap and opened activities and configure. The roadmap gives target months and scope, not deployment mechanics.

claims.claim: Prerequisites specific to the new alert classification capability are not stated.
claims.quote: Searched: "Insider Risk Management" "classification" "prerequisites" "reasons"; opened configure, permissions and activities. General product requirements are documented, but no classification-specific prerequisites.

claims.claim: The Microsoft Purview portal route Settings > Roles and groups > Roles groups > role group reaches the role-group page used to manage membership.
claims.quote:
Select the Insider Risk Management role group, then select Edit.
Select Choose users, then select the checkboxes for all the users you want to add to the role group.
claims.fix: Extend controls[0].ui.path and the rendered route to 'Settings > Roles and groups > Roles groups > role group > Edit > Choose users', as documented at https://learn.microsoft.com/purview/insider-risk-management-permissions. The existing route stops on the right page but before the membership controls.

claims.claim: Add-RoleGroupMember -Identity "Insider Risk Management Analysts" -Member <user-UPN> adds the specified user to the role group.
claims.quote:
Use the Add-RoleGroupMember cmdlet to add members to a management role group.
The Identity parameter specifies the role group to add a member to.
User ID or user principal name (UPN)

claims.claim: Insider Risk Management and Insider Risk Management Admins members, Entra Global Administrator and Compliance Administrator roles, and Purview Organization Management and Compliance Administrator groups can perform the role-assignment configuration.
claims.quote: Microsoft Entra ID Global Administrator role; Microsoft Entra ID Compliance Administrator role; Microsoft Purview Organization Management role group; Microsoft Purview Compliance Administrator role group; Insider Risk Management role group; Insider Risk Management Admins role group

claims.claim: Role-group permissions can take up to 30 minutes to apply.
claims.quote: After configuring your role groups, it might take up to 30 minutes for the role group permissions to apply to assigned users across your organization.

claims.claim: No source states that this change alters detection or who sees alerts.
claims.quote: Searched: "Purview" "alert classification" "data" "rollout" and "insider risk" "alert classification" permissions settings enable default PowerShell; read roadmap, activities and permissions. No detection or visibility change for this feature is stated.

claims.claim: No new data source is described for alert classification.
claims.quote: Searched: "Purview" "alert classification" "data" "rollout"; read roadmap and opened insider-risk-management-activities. Neither describes a new data source for this classification capability.

claims.claim: No automated action is described for the new classification capability.
claims.quote: Searched: "insider risk" "alert classification" "True positive" and "Purview" "alert classification" "data" "rollout"; read roadmap and activities. The roadmap describes analyst choices, not automated classification actions.

claims.claim: The new classification feature reads no new data.
claims.quote: Searched: "Purview" "alert classification" "data" "rollout"; read roadmap and opened insider-risk-management-activities. They do not state what data classification reads; lack of a described new source does not establish that it reads none.
claims.fix: Replace the risk rationale with: "Low. The roadmap describes classification of alerts analysts already triage and describes no new data source; the default state is not stated, so this is rated on today's triage behaviour continuing."
